title: Eric DeCosta: When the lights have come on, Trey Hendrickson has brought it

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eric DeCosta: When the lights have come on, Trey Hendrickson has brought it
sources.description: Back in March, it seemed like the Ravens quickly pivoted to signing Trey Hendrickson once they backed out of the trade for Maxx Crosby due to long-term concerns about his knee.
